notes.zh:
修复：安装/用户名路径含 % 字符时 Windows CLI wrapper 生成的路径段不再被吞掉（此前 CLI 硬损坏且无法自愈）
修复：内核升级器新增整体看门狗——极端环境下升级卡死不再永久挂起，自动回滚并恢复启动
修复：应用更新「重启以安装」重复点击不再并发两个安装器互踩；升级失败且网关恢复失败时错误提示明确透出
稳定性：扩展插件升级改为原子换装（复制中途失败不再留下残缺目录）；用户 shell 配置文件与配置恢复路径改为原子写，崩溃/断电不再损坏
稳定性：设置页浏览器探测新增超时——异常环境下不再无限转圈；启动链路扩展目录创建失败不再中断网关启动
测试基线 499 用例全绿
notes.en:
Fix: Windows CLI wrapper no longer corrupts paths containing % characters (previously hard-broken with no self-heal)
Fix: kernel updater now has an overall watchdog — a stuck upgrade no longer hangs forever; auto-rollback and gateway restore take over
Fix: double-clicking restart-to-install no longer spawns two competing installers; explicit error wording when the gateway fails to recover after an upgrade failure
Stability: extension plugin upgrade is now an atomic swap (a mid-copy failure no longer leaves a partial directory); user shell config files and the config-restore path use atomic writes, so crashes/power loss can no longer corrupt them
Stability: settings browser probing now has timeouts — no more infinite spinners in abnormal environments; extensions-dir creation failure no longer aborts gateway startup
499-test baseline all green

notes.zh:
安全：修复工作区符号链接逃逸——工作区内指向外部凭据文件的符号链接不再能绕过目录守卫被读取
修复：聊天界面加载失败时的错误页「Retry」按钮现在真正可用（此前永远无效）
修复：发送在途时切换会话不再把错误卡片/自动命名误送到新会话
修复：代码块复制按钮不再在代码末尾混入语言标签
修复：中断对话时上游生成请求同步终止（避免继续计费）；首条消息自动命名在失败时不再静默丢失
优化：网关停止/端口清理不再冻结主进程最长 10 秒；导出状态包不再卡住界面；长任务工具流渲染内存上限；日志轮转异常恢复
优化：构建链加固——内核补丁未命中时中止打包（防发出坏包）、发版产物哈希一致性
测试基线 499 用例全绿（新增 2 用例）
notes.en:
Security: fixed a workspace symlink escape — symlinks pointing at credential files outside the workspace can no longer bypass the directory guard
Fix: the error-page Retry button now actually works (previously always dead)
Fix: switching sessions while a send is in flight no longer misroutes error cards / auto-naming to the new session
Fix: copying code blocks no longer appends the language label to the code
Fix: aborting a conversation now terminates the upstream request immediately (no wasted billing); first-message auto-naming is retried instead of silently lost on failure
Improved: gateway stop / stale-port cleanup no longer freezes the main process for up to 10s; state export no longer blocks the UI; memory cap for long tool-stream renders; log-rotation self-recovery
Improved: hardened build chain — abort packaging when the kernel patch misses (prevents shipping broken builds), release artifact hash consistency
499-test baseline all green (+2 new cases)

notes.zh:

修复：无状态字段的子代理任务不再被误判为运行中（防僵尸等待卡）

notes.en:
Fix: file cards now use a phrasing-safe inline root element so message paragraphs are no longer implicitly broken
Fix: subagent tasks without a status field are no longer treated as running (prevents stuck wait cards)
499-test baseline all green

notes.zh:
新功能：历史消息中的非图片文件（文档/表格/压缩/音视频/代码等）现在以文件卡片展示——点击打开，卡片内按钮可在文件夹中显示

notes.en:
New: non-image files in legacy MEDIA:<path> markers (documents, spreadsheets, archives, media, code) now render as file cards — click to open, in-card button to show in folder
New: while the main turn waits for subagents, the chat shows subagent status cards (title / state / progress summary) and the reading indicator reflects the wait
Improved: reconnect now rebuilds interrupted streaming views from persisted history; transient empty history reads no longer wipe the local conversation
Improved: post-turn usage/session list refresh is faster (1.5s → 0.8s)

notes.en:
New: per-model capability editing on model cards — context window (128K/256K/512K/1M presets), maxTokens, image/video/audio input, reasoning mode & thinking levels
New: Add-model button next to each group — reuses the group's endpoint & API key automatically
New: video/audio capability badges on model cards

notes.zh:

优化：退出时自动清理临时缓存（保留用户配置与会话历史）；收敛无用 Chromium 特性降低内存占用
优化：渲染进程崩溃自愈与内存软监控；设置/聊天界面图标统一为 lucide 风格
修复：自动更新换装流程（重启安装不再静默失败）

notes.en:
New: app auto-update moved to GitHub Releases (check/download/one-click restart-to-install in Settings → About, differential downloads)
New: Export Diagnostics bundle in Settings → Advanced (logs + runtime info in one click)
Improved: unified logging to ~/.openclaw/logs/ (app.log/gateway.log, CRYOCLAW_LOG_LEVEL filtering)
Improved: V8 compile cache for Gateway (faster warm starts); earlier main-window creation
Improved: temp caches cleaned on quit (user config & chat history kept); unused Chromium features disabled to cut memory
Improved: renderer crash self-healing & memory soft-watchdog; settings/chat icons unified to lucide
Fix: update swap flow (restart-to-install no longer fails silently)
487-test baseline all green

notes.zh:
修复：Kimi K3 系模型思考强度档位（low/medium/high/xhigh/max）现在按模型能力正确开放，不再被误限为开/关二值
修复：/new、/reset 开启新会话时立即清空旧对话并及时刷新
修复：上下文自动压缩后新回复不再消失；子代理结束时不再误清空进行中的工具卡片
修复：渠道/模型设置页输入框与下拉选择即时响应

notes.en:
Fix: thinking levels for Kimi K3 models (low/medium/high/xhigh/max) now correctly follow model capabilities instead of a binary on/off
Fix: /new and /reset instantly clear the old conversation and refresh
Fix: replies no longer vanish after automatic context compaction; sub-agent completion no longer wipes in-progress tool cards
Fix: channel/model settings inputs and dropdowns respond immediately
New: capability badges (thinking / context window) on model cards; Xiaomi MiMo and Ollama quick presets
Improved: subtle entrance animation for new messages; honors system reduced-motion preference

notes.zh:
新功能：设置页新增「插件」tab——已安装插件清单（启停/卸载），内置 ClawHub 插件市场（搜索、一键安装）
新功能：消息悬停「引用」插入 markdown 引用块；发送失败错误卡片带「重发」按钮
新功能：快捷键 Ctrl+N 新建对话、Ctrl+L 聚焦输入框
优化：回放/分支成功后自动收起回放面板并刷新列表；终态刷新防消息短暂消失

notes.en:
New: Plugins tab in Settings — installed plugin inventory (enable/disable/uninstall) with the built-in ClawHub plugin marketplace (search & one-click install)
New: hover-to-quote inserts markdown blockquotes; failed sends get a Resend button
New: Ctrl+N new chat, Ctrl+L focus composer
Improved: rewind/fork panel auto-closes and refreshes; terminal refresh no longer briefly hides messages
Upgrade: Electron 40 → 43 (high-severity sandbox CVE fixed, startup perf, 0 audit vulns)
Storage: gateway.asar trimmed by another ~10MB (.pdb debug symbols); 468-test baseline

notes.zh: 修复：历史消息中的 MEDIA:<路径> 标记现在渲染为真实图片（此前仅显示为纯文本/路径链接）；加载失败自动回退原文，点击可全屏预览
notes.en: Fix: legacy MEDIA:<path> markers in historical messages now render as actual images (previously shown as plain text/path links); falls back to raw text when the file is unreadable, click for fullscreen preview

notes.zh: 阅读体验：对话中的 LaTeX 公式（$$块级$$ 与 $行内$）现在用 KaTeX 渲染为专业排版（按需加载不拖累首屏，识别启发式防金额文本误判，渲染失败保留原文）
notes.en: Reading experience: LaTeX math ($$block$$ and $inline$) in chat is now rendered with KaTeX (loaded on demand, heuristic guards against false positives like currency amounts, falls back to raw text on failure)

notes.zh: 阅读体验：代码块左上角新增语言标签（python/js 等，mono 弱显示），代码区顶部自动留白防遮挡
notes.en: Reading experience: code blocks now show a language label (python/js etc., muted mono) at top-left, with automatic top padding to keep code clear

notes.zh: 阅读体验：代码块新增语法高亮（highlight.js 按需加载，覆盖 JS/TS/Python/JSON/Bash/SQL/Go/Rust 等 15 种常用语言，配色随浅/暗主题自动适配）
notes.en: Reading experience: code blocks now get syntax highlighting (highlight.js loaded on demand, 15 common languages incl. JS/TS/Python/JSON/Bash/SQL/Go/Rust; colors adapt to light/dark theme automatically)

notes.zh: 操作体验：对话中的每个代码块新增一键复制按钮（悬停显现，复制成功/失败有即时反馈）
notes.en: Interaction: every code block in chat now has a one-click copy button (reveals on hover, with instant copied/failed feedback)

notes.zh:
阅读体验：对话中的 markdown 标题有了层级样式（字号/间距收敛），GFM 表格首次获得边框、内边距与斑马纹，宽表格横向滚动不再撑破气泡
新功能：markdown 渲染引擎支持 GFM 任务列表（- [x] 渲染为只读复选框），解析异常自动退化为纯文本不再拖垮单条消息
安全：修复 25 个依赖漏洞（含打包链路的严重级 node-tar 路径穿越；chat-ui 侧 dompurify/vite 等 7 项清零）
工程：新增 tests CI 工作流（每次提交全量回归）；移除不适用于本仓库的上游签名/CDN 发版工作流
notes.en:
Reading experience: markdown headings in chat get a proper type scale, and GFM tables are now styled (borders, padding, zebra rows) with horizontal scroll instead of breaking the bubble
New: markdown engine renders GFM task lists (- [x] as read-only checkboxes); parse failures degrade to plain text instead of breaking the message
Security: fixed 25 dependency vulnerabilities (incl. critical node-tar path traversal in the packaging chain; chat-ui dompurify/vite etc. all cleared)
Engineering: new tests CI workflow (full regression on every commit); removed upstream signing/CDN release workflows that don't apply to this fork

notes.zh:
新功能：模型管理支持自定义分组——新建/重命名/删除/拖拽排序分组，把模型指派进组后，聊天与定时任务的模型选择器按分组显示
优化：模型管理页新增搜索框（按名称/ID 过滤）、模型卡片直接显示「默认 / 备用 N」徽标，备用链与卡片一目了然
优化：模型选择器中默认模型带「默认」标记，多模型时更容易辨认
notes.en:
New: custom groups in model management — create/rename/delete/drag-reorder groups, assign models to them, and the model selector in chat and scheduled tasks displays them as sections
Improved: model management page gains a search box (filter by name/ID) and inline Default / Fallback N badges on model cards
Improved: the default model is labeled in the model selector for easier recognition

notes.zh:
全新版本：更名 CryoClaw，启用全新冰蓝视觉设计（浅色/暗色双主题）
新功能：模型管理重构——provider 分组、密钥真实有效性探测、备用模型（fallback）配置
新功能：终端会话列表与用量展示接入实时事件推送，状态更新更及时
优化：对话流式渲染改为逐帧纯文本渲染，长回复不再越滚越卡；完整排版在回复结束时一次性呈现
优化：折叠的工具调用区域首次展开才渲染，长会话滚动与切换明显更轻快
优化：存储裁剪——移除非本机平台原生依赖、插件冗余类型声明与前端 sourcemap，应用体积显著缩小
优化：官方插件更新（飞书/QQ 机器人等）；移除 kimi-claw 插件，能力由内置功能替代
修复：诊断日志改为异步写盘，主进程不再因高频日志卡顿
notes.en:
New era: renamed to CryoClaw with an all-new ice-blue visual design (light/dark themes)
New: rebuilt model management — provider grouping, real API-key validation, fallback model configuration
New: terminal session list and usage now update via realtime events
Improved: streaming replies render per-frame as plain text — long answers no longer degrade; full formatting applied once when the reply finishes
Improved: collapsed tool-call sections render lazily on first expand — long sessions scroll and switch noticeably faster
Improved: storage trimming — removed off-platform native deps, redundant plugin type declarations and frontend sourcemaps, significantly smaller app size
Improved: official plugin updates (Feishu/QQ Bot etc.); kimi-claw plugin removed, replaced by built-in features
Fixed: diagnostic logging is now asynchronous — no more main-process hiccups under heavy logging

notes.zh:
修复：技能提案（Apply workspace skill proposal）审批现在会直接显示在对话框上方，可批准/拒绝（此前只进设置页历史，70 秒超时后必然失败）
修复：计划悬浮面板下移，不再与窗口最小化/最大化/关闭按钮重叠
修复：工具输出侧栏头部、顶部错误条不再被窗口标题栏压住；任务视图顶部留白对齐其它页面
安全修复：安装包不再误打包 .env.build 构建配置、.cache 调试缓存与重复资源（安装包体积减半，回归 ~134MB）
优化：侧栏会话菜单靠近底部时自动向上展开；多条审批并存时审批面板限高可滚动；顶部提示条让开标题栏并限宽
优化：「有新消息」按钮改为悬浮，不再推动输入区跳动
notes.en:
Fix: skill proposal approvals (Apply workspace skill proposal) now appear above the composer with approve/deny (previously only logged in Settings, always expiring after 70s)
Fix: plan floating panel moved down, no longer overlapping window min/max/close buttons
Fix: tool-output sidebar header and top error banner no longer hidden under the title bar; tasks view top padding aligned
Security: installer no longer bundles .env.build, .cache debug data or duplicated resources (installer size halved, back to ~134MB)
Improve: sidebar session menu flips upward near the bottom; approval panel is height-capped and scrollable; top toasts clear the title bar and are width-capped
Improve: new-message button floats instead of pushing the composer around

notes.zh:
新功能：任务进行时发送的消息进入队列，队列消息现在可编辑、可删除、可点「立即发送」插队
新功能：模型自动切换到备用模型（fallback）时界面会给出提示，恢复主模型时也有提示
优化：任务进行中「停止」和「发送」按钮并列显示，发送即入队；排队提示文案更明确
安全：设置页 API Key 一律掩码显示，未修改的 Key 保存时不再回传；诊断接口不再下发明文 Key
优化：运行失败只显示消息流内的警告卡片（不再顶部、卡片双份提示）
优化：所有系统确认框替换为应用内统一风格（删除会话/重置/回滚等危险操作为红色确认）
notes.en:
New: messages sent during a run are queued — queue items can now be edited, deleted, or sent immediately
New: a notice appears when the model falls back to a backup model, and when it recovers
Improved: Stop and Send buttons now coexist during a run (send = enqueue); clearer queue hint
Security: API keys are masked in settings; unchanged keys are never re-sent; config API no longer returns plaintext keys
Improved: run failures show only the inline warning card (no more duplicate banner + card)
Improved: all native confirm dialogs replaced with the app's own style (danger actions get a red confirm)

notes.zh:
新功能：模型使用 update_plan 制定计划时，右侧出现悬浮计划面板，实时更新进度，悬停查看完整步骤
新功能：工具调用现在有三种状态指示——执行中（旋转动画）、完成（✓）、失败（红色 ✗）
优化：运行失败的消息显示为醒目的警告卡片；消息气泡增加淡入动画
视觉：全新应用图标（橙虾吉祥物），修复 Windows 深色任务栏托盘图标几乎不可见的问题
视觉：安装/卸载向导使用应用图标；窗口任务栏图标修正；界面增加 favicon
其它：启用内核 update_plan 工具（新装与存量均自动开启）；清理废弃样式与资源
notes.en:
New: when the model uses update_plan, a floating plan panel appears on the right — live progress, hover to expand all steps
New: tool calls now show three states — running (spinner), done (✓), failed (red ✗)
Improved: failed runs appear as prominent warning cards; message bubbles fade in
Visual: all-new app icon (lobster mascot); fixed tray icon nearly invisible on dark Windows taskbar
Visual: installer/uninstaller wizard icon; fixed window taskbar icon; added favicon
More: kernel update_plan tool enabled (fresh installs and existing users); dead styles and assets cleaned up

notes.zh: 安全加固：渲染层控制台日志转发统一脱敏，诊断日志（app.log）中不再出现网关令牌
notes.en: Security hardening: renderer console forwarding is now sanitized — gateway tokens no longer appear in diagnostic logs (app.log)

notes.zh:
修复：多条命令待审批时，点哪条就批哪条（之前总是批准第一条）
修复：技能安装超过 30 秒被误报失败；卸载已安装技能可能失败
修复：工作区文件加载失败一直转圈、快速切换文件内容错位
修复：微信扫码登录离开设置页后后台空转；点「⋯」菜单按钮中途消失
修复：点击对话中的文件路径无反应时现在会提示；安全日志不再写入网关令牌
视觉：输入区恢复渐隐过渡；移除界面中的全大写英文样式；清理约 2500 行废弃样式

notes.en:

Fix: WeChat QR login polling kept running after leaving settings; session '⋯' button vanished mid-menu

Visual: composer fade restored; removed uppercase styling; ~2500 lines of dead CSS cleaned up
More: completed zh/en translations; cleaner app shutdown; dozens of stability & polish fixes

Cleanup: removed the duplicate approval modal and dead code
